instruction: Please help me change the font throughout my entire presentation to 'Liberation Serif'. I don't want to manually update each text box.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all fonts in a 28-slide presentation from Arial to Liberation Serif. Evaluator extracts all unique fonts and verifies only 'Liberation Serif' is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly iterates through all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and runs to extract all font names
Metric correctly verifies that only Liberation Serif is present using set equality check
Data flow is correct: getter extracts all unique fonts, metric checks for single expected font
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before verification, ensuring changes are persisted to disk
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: changing all fonts throughout entire presentation
Edge case handled: getter checks if run.font.name exists before adding to set
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider documenting that text in complex shapes (SmartArt, charts) without text_frame attribute may not be detected
Consider noting that text runs with inherited/theme fonts (where font.name is None or not explicitly set) might not be captured
The 15-second sleep after save should be sufficient for most cases, but could be extended for very large presentations if needed
